info.title: ONESOURCE Indirect Tax Compliance - Reports API

get.description: This endpoint is used to retrieve the list of all Reports available in the system (Both Standard and Custom).

This endpoint fetches the parameters required to run a specific Report along with the list of fields in the report output. Report output fields are the output columns which this particular report will fetch and display.

post.description: This endpoint is used to Queue reports for execution, based on the input parameters. The input parameters required are retrieved by calling the 'Report MetaData' endpoint first. Once obtained, these values are passed as input to execute 'Run Report'.

get.description: This endpoint is used to get the latest status of a report that has been queued using the 'Run Report' endpoint. When you queue a report using 'Run Report', you receive a 'run-id' in the response. Pass that 'run-id' as the id parameter in this endpoint's URL to retrieve the report status.

This endpoint is used to fetch the data in Json array format which was requested or queued from 'Run Report' endpoint. 'run-id' generated from the 'Run Report' should be passed as the 'id' parameter in the URL in order to retrive the data.

parameters.description: Specifies the starting position in the result set. With offset=1, you're skipping the first record and starting from the second one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of records to return in a single response. With limit=20, you're requesting up to 20 records in this call
